skill.name: linkedin-automation
skill.description: Guides AI agents through LinkedIn post, comment, profile, company, deletion, and image workflows using Rube MCP and current tool schemas.
skill.summary: Runs LinkedIn publishing and account workflows through Rube MCP with OAuth-backed LinkedIn tools.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks around Rube and LinkedIn tool names, not executable shell code. The confirmed static issue is the documented third-party Rube MCP endpoint. Semantic review adds medium-risk concerns for live LinkedIn actions and OAuth data sharing, with no evidence of prompt injection.

remediation.issue: External MCP endpoint and OAuth connection
remediation.suggestion: Document what LinkedIn data Rube receives, require users to verify https://rube.app/mcp, and ask for consent before connecting.

remediation.issue: Live publishing, commenting, media upload, and deletion workflows
remediation.suggestion: Add mandatory confirmation gates before creating posts, creating comments, uploading media, or deleting posts.

remediation.issue: Repeated LinkedIn activity can trigger platform limits
remediation.suggestion: Add clear batch limits, backoff steps, and stop conditions for 429 responses before repeated post or comment creation.

static_findings.snippet: - Active LinkedIn connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `linkedin`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. Call `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `linkedin`
1. `LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO` - Get authenticated user's profile info [Prerequisite]
2. `LINKEDIN_REGISTER_IMAGE_UPLOAD` - Register image upload if post includes an image [Optional]
3. `LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST` - Publish the post [Required]
- `text`: Post content text
- `visibility`: 'PUBLIC' or 'CONNECTIONS'
- `media_title`: Title for attached media
- `media_description`: Description for attached media
1. `LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO` - Get authenticated user's profile [Required]
2. `LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO` - Get company page details [Optional]
- `organization_id`: Company/organization ID for GET_COMPANY_INFO
1. `LINKEDIN_REGISTER_IMAGE_UPLOAD` - Register an image upload with LinkedIn [Required]
3. `LINKEDIN_GET_IMAGES` - Verify uploaded image status [Optional]
4. `LINKEDIN_CREATE_LINKED_IN_POST` - Create post with the image asset [Required]
- `owner`: URN of the image owner (user or organization)
- `image_id`: ID of the uploaded image for GET_IMAGES
1. `LINKEDIN_CREATE_COMMENT_ON_POST` - Add a comment to a post [Required]
- `post_id`: The URN or ID of the post to comment on
- `text`: Comment content
- `actor`: URN of the commenter (user or organization)
1. `LINKEDIN_DELETE_LINKED_IN_POST` - Delete the specified post [Required]
- `post_id`: The URN or ID of the post to delete
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Post ID must be a valid LinkedIn URN format
- Rate limits apply to comment creation; avoid rapid-fire comments
- The post_id must be the exact URN returned when the post was created
1. Call LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO with organization_id
| Get company info | LINKEDIN_GET_COMPANY_INFO | organization_id |
| Get uploaded images | LINKEDIN_GET_IMAGES | image_id |
| Delete post | LINKEDIN_DELETE_LINKED_IN_POST | post_id |

content.user_title: Automate LinkedIn Publishing With Rube MCP
content.value_statement: LinkedIn API workflows are hard to sequence because IDs, OAuth scopes, and image uploads must be handled correctly. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through common LinkedIn workflows using Rube MCP.
actual_capabilities: Guides setup of Rube MCP and LinkedIn OAuth connection.
Shows tool sequences for text and image LinkedIn posts.
Explains authenticated profile and company information retrieval.
Documents comment creation and post deletion workflows.
Covers URNs, image upload steps, rate limits, and content restrictions.
limitations: Requires an active Rube MCP server and LinkedIn OAuth connection.
Cannot look up arbitrary LinkedIn users through the documented profile workflow.
Tool schemas and OAuth scopes may change outside the skill.
Publishing and deletion should require explicit user approval.

use_cases.title: Publish Campaign Updates
use_cases.description: Plan and publish LinkedIn posts with clear visibility settings and optional image attachments.

use_cases.title: Resolve LinkedIn Account IDs
use_cases.description: Retrieve the authenticated profile URN or company organization details before using LinkedIn tools.

use_cases.title: Build Guarded LinkedIn Workflows
use_cases.description: Create repeatable MCP workflows for posts, comments, deletion, and rate-limit handling.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Text Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner post publishing with user approval.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to publish this text post: [post text]. Show me the final content first. Ask for confirmation. Set visibility to [PUBLIC or CONNECTIONS].

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Profile and Company Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Find required account identifiers before posting.
prompt_templates.prompt: Get my profile info with Rube MCP. Then get company details for organization_id [id]. Summarize required URNs and OAuth scopes before using them.

prompt_templates.title: Publish an Image Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Post media through the two-step LinkedIn image flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a LinkedIn image post with [image source] and [caption]. Register the upload. Verify image status. Show the final post. Wait for approval before publishing.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Safe Campaign Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design with platform safeguards.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a repeatable LinkedIn workflow for [campaign or use case] using current Rube schemas. Include confirmation gates, rate limits, ID validation, and delete rollback notes.

output_examples.input: Create a public LinkedIn post about our new hiring guide.
output_examples.output: The assistant retrieves the profile URN, drafts the post, asks for approval, then publishes with public visibility after confirmation.

output_examples.input: Publish this product screenshot with a short caption.
output_examples.output: The assistant registers image upload, uploads the file to the returned LinkedIn URL, verifies status, and prepares the post for approval.

output_examples.input: Remove the test post I created yesterday.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for the exact post URN, confirms deletion risk, then calls the delete tool only after approval.

best_practices: Ask for explicit approval before posting, commenting, uploading media, or deleting content.
Confirm the authenticated identity, OAuth scopes, visibility, and target URN before each write action.
Respect LinkedIn rate limits and stop repeated actions when 429 responses appear.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated content without a final human review.
Using company names or vanity URLs when an organization ID is required.
Running bulk comment or post workflows without rate-limit controls.

faq.question: Does this skill publish content automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide publishing, but users should require confirmation before any post, comment, media upload, or deletion.

faq.question: What services does it require?
faq.answer: It requires Rube MCP and an active LinkedIn OAuth connection.

faq.question: Can it read other LinkedIn profiles?
faq.answer: No. The documented profile lookup returns the authenticated user, and company lookup needs an organization ID.

faq.question: Can it post with images?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents the register, upload, verify, and publish flow for LinkedIn images.

faq.question: Does it manage rate limits?
faq.answer: It warns about LinkedIn rate limits and recommends backoff, but the agent must apply the strategy.

faq.question: Can it delete LinkedIn posts?
faq.answer: Yes, when the authenticated user or managed organization has permission and the exact post URN is provided.
